name: registry_validate_args
notes: Centralized tool-input validation (P0). Compiled against real libjson + hermes_tool_result. 9 assertions: valid->NULL, non-object->error, wrong-type->named error, missing-required->named error, numeric-string tolerated, union accept/reject. Root-caused 2 latent libjson bugs (json_len vs json_object_size; json_get index vs json_object_get_at) and a dangling-pointer-after-free in the error path. Wired into registry_dispatch (both main + repaired paths).
